moa.t: Raises ionised calcium, stabilises the cardiac membrane in hyperkalaemia, antidote for magnesium toxicity

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

dosing.h: Choice of drugs for post-partum hypertension

items.t: If respiratory depression occurs, give Calcium gluconate 10%, IV, 10 mL slowly at a rate not exceeding 5 mL/ minute. Postpartum and postnatal care

cautions.t: Never mix with bicarbonate, phosphate or ceftriaxone

adverse_effects.t: Bradycardia and arrhythmias if given fast, hypotension, tissue necrosis on extravasation
